title: Sunrise on Lake Victoria, and every spot after it
summary: EXAMPLE THREAD (hidden draft): replace with your own trip. A morning in Kisumu: the 6am ride to the lake, Dunga Beach at golden hour and lunch by the water.

posts.text: Took the 6am ride out of Kisumu to catch sunrise on the lake. Worth every yawn. Here are the spots I found, in order:
Dunga Beach at golden hour. Ask the fishermen first and they'll let you photograph the boats coming in.
Lunch by the water: fresh tilapia and ugali. Sit facing west.
